4.rung_why: Prepare is code, but whether to pass --resume-refresh (decision 0038) is described only in Definitions; no step says when.

extra_silent.decision: Whether a re-run after a FAILED run is a --resume-refresh, a fresh run or a new analysis
extra_silent.goes_wrong: Definitions describe re-preparing a FAILED run in place so a params change rides -resume from cached tasks, but no step says when; the model decides whether the user's 'try again with X' qualifies, and the gate checks only that STATUS says FAILED and Nextflow state exists
extra_silent.why_rank: Confusion over what was re-run rather than a wrong result: Nextflow re-runs every task whose parameters changed
extra_silent.fix: A recovery step in the Process naming the conditions and asking the user to choose resume or a fresh run
